data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘naym’, meaning 'rest' or 'relax'. Nuaimah signifies a beautiful and graceful woman who brings tranquility and peace. The name Nuaimah carries the meaning “Graceful, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuaimah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
